Name: Elliott and Harvey Rival Hearts Mod
Author: PinkParadox
Description:
I've always thought these two particular Pelican Town older bachelors would make a great couple! I thought about writing a fanfic, but then I decided to put together a mod that let them date each other. Because that was much easier. 😆
[center]﻿[/center]
[color=#ffff00][size=5]How to trigger events:[/size][/color][color=#ffff00] [/color]

2 Heart: When you have two hearts with both Elliott and Harvey, go to the doctor's office between 9 AM and 3 PM.

4 Heart: When you have four hearts with both Elliott and Harvey, go to the library between 1 PM and 6 PM.

6 Heart: When you have six hearts with both Elliott and Harvey, and it's sunny, and you've seen Harvey's vanilla six heart event, go to the town between 11 AM and 2 PM.

8 Heart Part 1: When you have eight hearts with both Elliott and Harvey, and you've seen Elliott's vanilla eight heart event, go to town between 12 PM and 6 PM.

8 Heart Part 2: After seeing Part 1, go to the saloon between 4 PM and 9 PM.

8 Heart Part 3: After seeing Part 2, and it's sunny, go to the beach between 1 PM and 3 PM.

Dating Event 1: After seeing all previous events, go to the saloon between 4 PM and 9 PM.

Dating Event 2: After seeing Dating Event 1, go to Harvey's room on Tuesday or Thursday between 9 AM and 3 PM.

Dating Event 3: After seeing Dating Event 2, go to the library between 10 AM and 2 PM.


[size=5][color=#ffff00]My plans for this mod further down the line:[/color] [/size]

Add more conversation topics for the rest of the town - give everyone a chance to comment on Elliott and Harvey's blossoming romance! --Some added in 1.1, with more to come!

[s]Change their schedules after they're dating so they hang out together![/s] --Added in 1.1!

[s]Add more events to show their dating life after their eight heart events![/s] --Added some in 1.1!

Include crossover content with other mods, such as ones that add family members for Elliott and Harvey!

Maybe a wedding! (If I can figure out the coding... 😅)
